senses.gloss: (v. מָצָה) to press, squeeze.—Denom. אֶמְצַע q. v.
(v. מָצָה Hithpa.) to be exact in calculation, to measure exactly.
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Eiruvin 4">Tosef. Erub. IV (III), 4</cite> <he>ואם מִיצְּעוּ את התחום וכ׳</he> and if they (those authorized to lay for him the Erub, v. <cite ref="P00680"><he>עֵירוּב</he></cite>) measured the Sabbath limit exactly (laying the Erub. in opposite directions, each exactly at 2000 cubits from his present place), he must not move from his place; <cite ref="Eruvin 50b">Erub. 50ᵇ</cite>; Y. ib. III, 21ᵇ <he>מיצע את וכ׳</he> if he had the Erub. laid &c. Ib. <he>מיצעת את וכ׳</he> (read <he>מִיצְּעוּ</he>) if they (the partners) laid the Erub. &c.; Tosef. ib. IX (VI), 12 <he>מיצע</he> (read: <he>מיצעו</he>); a. e.

senses.gloss: (denom. of אֶמְצַע) to place in the middle.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Sanhedrin 2:1">Snh. II, 1</cite> <he>מְמַצְּעוֹ</he>, v. <cite ref="M01653"><he>מְמוּנֶּה</he></cite>. Y. Ber. V, end, 9ᵈ <he>מְמַצְּעִין את הכהן</he> the priest is called upon to read between the two common Israelites.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 95:1">Gen. R. s. 95</cite> <he>היו מְמַצְּעִים אותו וכ׳</he> they took him in the middle and guarded him.
Pes. 111ᵃ שלשה אין ממצעין ולא מִתְמַצְּעִין there are three objects we must not allow to pass between two persons, nor must any person be passed between them.—Part. pass. מְמוּצָּע

<cite ref="Zevachim 58b:12">Zeb. 58ᵇ</cite> <he>מזבח ממ׳ ועומד וכ׳</he> the altar was placed exactly in the centre of the Temple; <cite ref="Yoma 16a">Yoma 16ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Yoma 33b">ib. 33ᵇ</cite>; Sifra Vayikra, N’dab., <cite ref="Mishnah Parah 5">Par. V</cite>, ch. VII <he>מְמֻצְּע</he>.

<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 2:5">Ex. R. s. 2</cite> <he>שהיה ממ׳ ועומד באמצע וכ׳</he> who was standing in the very centre of the fire. Y. Ber. IV, 8ᵇ top <he>גדולה … שהיא מְמוּצַּעַת וכ׳</he> knowledge is something great, for it is placed between two divine names (<cite ref="I Samuel 2:3">I Sam. II, 3</cite>).
